headline_marked: 19 dead in [[Kolkata Durga Puja stampede]] after exit gate collapse
headline: 19 dead in Kolkata Durga Puja stampede after exit gate collapse
summary: At least 19 people were killed and 25 injured when a portion of the exit gate structure collapsed at a community pandal in North Kolkata.
details: At least 19 people died in a stampede at the Chorbagan Sarbojonin community Durga Puja pandal on Muktarambabu Street in North Kolkata. According to West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari, 17 of the victims died on the spot.
The tragedy occurred on Saturday when tension broke out among visitors after a portion of the exit gate structure collapsed, triggering the stampede.
Chief Minister Adhikari stated that 25 people were injured, with 24 now out of danger and one remaining in critical condition.

The West Bengal government has announced 2.5 lakh rupees in compensation and a job for every affected family, while bearing 100% of the medical expenses for the injured along with an additional 5 lakh rupees.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed his condolences on X, announcing an ex-gratia of 2 lakh rupees for the next of kin of the deceased and 50,000 rupees for the injured.
In response to the incident, the Chief Minister urged all 58,000 Pujas across the state to exercise caution and strictly follow fire brigade and police directions regarding safety and crowd control.
caption:
19 people killed in a stampede at a Kolkata Durga Puja pandal. A collapsed exit gate triggered the chaos.

At least 19 people died in a stampede at the Chorbagan Sarbojonin community Durga Puja pandal on Muktarambabu Street in North Kolkata. According to West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari, 17 of the victims died on the spot.

The tragedy occurred on Saturday when tension broke out among visitors after a portion of the exit gate structure collapsed, triggering the stampede.

Chief Minister Adhikari stated that 25 people were injured, with 24 now out of danger and one remaining in critical condition.

The West Bengal government has announced 2.5 lakh rupees in compensation and a job for every affected family, while bearing 100% of the medical expenses for the injured along with an additional 5 lakh rupees.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed his condolences on X, announcing an ex-gratia of 2 lakh rupees for the next of kin of the deceased and 50,000 rupees for the injured.

In response to the incident, the Chief Minister urged all 58,000 Pujas across the state to exercise caution and strictly follow fire brigade and police directions regarding safety and crowd control.

headline_marked: 10 killed in Cox's Bazar resort fire; [[Police sue resort owner, manager]]
headline: 10 killed in Cox's Bazar resort fire; Police sue resort owner, manager
summary: A devastating fire at the wooden Tup-Tup Resort in Inani Beach, Ukhiya, has left 10 people dead, leading to legal action against the management.
details: A fire broke out at the wooden Tup-Tup Resort on Patuartaek Beach, Inani, Ukhiya, Cox's Bazar, resulting in the deaths of 10 people.
Police have filed a case against the resort owner and the manager, who has already been arrested.
The tragedy has left families devastated, with some relatives still searching for missing loved ones who were staying at the resort.
One survivor expressed deep regret, stating that if he had just a minute or two more, he could have saved his wife.
Ten bodies have been kept in the morgue as relatives arrive to identify their deceased family members.
The incident has outsparked concerns over the safety of wooden resort structures in tourist destinations.
caption:

A fire broke out at the wooden Tup-Tup Resort on Patuartaek Beach, Inani, Ukhiya, Cox's Bazar, resulting in the deaths of 10 people.

The tragedy has left families devastated, with some relatives still searching for missing loved ones who were staying at the resort.

One survivor expressed deep regret, stating that if he had just a minute or two more, he could have saved his wife.

Ten bodies have been kept in the morgue as relatives arrive to identify their deceased family members.

The incident has outsparked concerns over the safety of wooden resort structures in tourist destinations.
